newsitem.title: UK: Details of UK wool sale - March 12.
newsitem.headline: Details of UK wool sale - March 12.

text.p: Wednesday's UK wool sale saw steady prices across the board with the exception of Picks and Supers which gained around four pence per kg to sell for between 100.5 and 103 pence per kg, according to further information from the British Wool Marketing Board.
Better quality Halfbreds traded in a range of 113-115 pence per kg with Cast types at 105-108 pence.
Crosses went for 110-118 pence per kg according to quality with Cast types losing a little off the top to sell at 107-109.5 as against 107-111 pence per kg at the last Bradford sale.
Swaledales fetched up to 97.5 pence per kg and Radnors around 116 pence.
A selection of Welsh wools secured 102 pence per kg with Casts settling at 98 pence.
The overall price indicator for the sale was unchanged at 103 pence.
The total 2.38 million catalogue included half a million kg of next season's clip, due to be sheared this summer, plus 200,000 kg current season forward wool.
All prices are greasy basis per kg.
The next official UK auction is a Scottish offering on March 26 and will be the last sale before the Easter recess. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
